en_title: Kevin Feige Reveals Why Marvel Fought to Keep Sadie Sink's Role in Spider-Man: Brand New Day a Secret
cn_title: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》为何藏琴·葛蕾？
subtitle: 答案终于揭晓
opus_summary: Sadie Sink在《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》中饰演琴·葛蕾，漫威影业总裁Kevin Feige解释称，隐瞒身份是为了给观众带来最佳首映周末体验。琴·葛蕾还将在未来的漫威电影宇宙中扮演关键角色。

paragraphs.en: Now that Spider-Man: Brand New Day has finally revealed Sadie Sink's mystery role, Marvel Studios boss Kevin Feige has shared why the comic book movie company fought so hard to keep it a secret.
paragraphs.cn: 如今，《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》终于揭晓了Sadie Sink饰演的神秘角色，漫威影业总裁Kevin Feige也解释了这家漫画电影公司为何竭力保守这一秘密。

paragraphs.en: Warning! Spoilers for Spider-Man: Brand New Day follow.
paragraphs.cn: 警告！下文包含《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》的剧透。

paragraphs.en: Sink plays… Jean Grey. Yes, fans, YouTube theorists, and just about everyone on the internet called it months ago, but that didn't stop Marvel Studios from playing its X-Men cards close to its chest for the new Tom Holland-led Spidey movie.
paragraphs.cn: Sink饰演的是……琴·葛蕾。没错，粉丝、YouTube理论分析者以及几乎所有网民几个月前就猜到了答案，但这并没有阻止漫威影业在这部由Tom Holland领衔的新《蜘蛛侠》电影中把X战警的牌捂得严严实实。

paragraphs.en: This version of comic book readers' treasured telepath was brought to the live-action world of the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) to play Spider-Man: Brand New Day's villain. She controls the minds of random New Yorkers, MJ (Zendaya), the Hulk (Mark Ruffalo), and the Punisher (Jon Bernthal), stops the city dead in its tracks, and tears apart the Department of Damage Control – but what was it all for?
paragraphs.cn: 这位漫画读者珍爱的心灵感应者被带入漫威电影宇宙（MCU）的真人世界，饰演《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》的反派。她控制了纽约市随机居民、MJ（Zendaya）、Hulk（Mark Ruffalo）和Punisher（Jon Bernthal）的思想，让整座城市陷入停滞，还撕毁了Damage Control部门——但这一切究竟是为了什么？

paragraphs.en: Sink was cast in the movie all the way back in March 2025, with even reports at the time suggesting a part as Jean Grey was on the table. Marvel stayed tight-lipped regardless of all of the online chatter that followed, eventually going on to not only include a very quiet Sink in pre-release marketing but to start poking fun at the situation in the days leading up to the premiere.
paragraphs.cn: 早在2025年3月，Sink就已经被选入这部电影，当时甚至有报道称琴·葛蕾一角也在考虑之列。无论随后网上出现了多少讨论，漫威始终守口如瓶，最终不仅在上映前宣传中让Sink安静地露面，还在首映前几天开始拿这件事开起玩笑。

paragraphs.en: After director Destin Daniel Cretton teased that Marvel had a "very real reason" to keep Sink's character's identity a secret, Feige finally broke his silence during a new interview with Variety . After more than a year of beating around the bush, his answer may leave you wanting more.
paragraphs.cn: 导演Destin Daniel Cretton曾透露，漫威隐瞒Sink角色身份有一个「非常现实的理由」。如今，Feige终于在接受《综艺》新采访时打破沉默。经过一年多的绕圈子，他给出的答案可能仍会让你觉得意犹未尽。

paragraphs.en: "It’s purely about creating the best possible opening weekend experience for the audience," Feige said.
paragraphs.cn: 「这纯粹是为了给观众创造尽可能好的首映周末体验。」Feige说。

paragraphs.en: According to him, it was all about the surprise. Marvel has, of course, kept major cameos and reveals a secret before, with Spider-Man: No Way Home being perhaps the most infamous example. When it comes to Sink as Jean Grey, though, the MCU puppeteer said there's a little more riding on what the X-Men character brings to the table than what she brought to just one movie.
paragraphs.cn: 据他所说，这一切都是为了保留惊喜。当然，漫威过去也曾对重要客串和反转严加保密，《蜘蛛侠：英雄无归》或许就是最著名的例子。不过，谈到Sink饰演琴·葛蕾时，这位漫威电影宇宙的操盘手表示，这名X战警角色所带来的意义，不只是她在一部电影中的表现，背后还承载着更多期待。

paragraphs.en: "Sadie’s character is one that our fans know has immense significance within the Marvel Universe, and she plays a key role in the future of the MCU," he explained. "I’m just happy that the secret is finally out and that Sadie can stop dodging the question."
paragraphs.cn: 他解释道：「Sadie饰演的角色在漫威宇宙中意义重大，我们的粉丝都知道这一点，而她将在MCU的未来中扮演关键角色。我只是很高兴秘密终于揭晓，Sadie也不用再躲避这个问题了。」

paragraphs.en: Sink hasn't had time to issue a public statement regarding her grand reveal, but that's probably because Spider-Man: Brand New Day is already tangling up headlines for other reasons. The new Spider-Man movie defied expectations by breaking records at the box office following its July 31 premiere. We're just now rounding out its fourth day in theaters, but after rounding up a whopping $930 million worldwide in its first weekend alone, it looks like $1 billion is just around the corner.
paragraphs.cn: Sink还没来得及就这次重磅揭晓发表公开声明，但这可能是因为《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》已经在其他方面占据了新闻头条。这部新的《蜘蛛侠》电影在7月31日首映后打破票房纪录，表现超出预期。电影上映才刚满第四天，但仅首个周末全球票房就高达9.3亿美元(约合人民币63亿元)，看起来距离10亿美元(约合人民币68亿元)已经不远了。

paragraphs.en: For more on the film, you can check out IGN's 7/10 review. You can also see what Sony Pictures executive Tom Rothman had to say about the anti-theater sentiment amongst some moviegoers , and what it would take to get Andrew Garfield back in costume .
paragraphs.cn: 想了解更多电影信息，可以阅读IGN的7/10评测。你还可以看看Sony Pictures高管Tom Rothman如何谈论部分观众反感影院的情绪，以及要怎样才能让Andrew Garfield重新穿上蜘蛛侠战衣。
